entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4 18-09-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Section 341,
323, 376, 511, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, this petitioner attempted to commit rape upon the minor niece of the informant.
4. The victim in her statement u/s 164 of the Cr.P.C has supported the aforesaid allegation.
5. Considering the facts of the case, nature of accusation and statement of victim recorded u/s 164 of the Cr.P.C., I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on pre arrest bail.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) BKS/-
